description: Problem 4 prompt-caching experiment: every model call, rebuilt from output/cache_experiment/*/ logs.

phases.preliminary: SUPERSEDED approach: 'disabled' = prompt_cache_options mode 'explicit' (ignored by provider). Runs 1-3 were Portkey response-cache replays (excluded); run 4 used force-refresh but still read cached tokens. Kept as evidence only.
phases.preliminary_option_a: Option A verification: 'disabled' = fresh per-call Request ID line first; both conditions use Portkey force-refresh.
phases.full: Full 12-document comparison under Option A. Paired design: each document runs under both conditions before the next; the first condition alternates (odd positions: disabled first).

field_notes.reported: Provider-reported via the API usage block (input_tokens includes cached and cache-write tokens).
field_notes.derived: uncached = input - cached - cache_write; cost (ACTUAL pricing under data/prices.json) = uncached*$0.10 + cached*$0.01 + cache_write*$0.125 + output*$0.50, per 1M tokens.
field_notes.hypothetical: NOT actual pricing: input_tokens*$0.10 + output*$0.50 per 1M, i.e. as if the provider neither read nor wrote any cache. For comparison only.
field_notes.request_sent: Evidence from the request actually sent: the per-call ID line (disabled condition) and SHA-256 hashes of the instructions without that line and of the tool definitions.
field_notes.raw_matches_parsed: True if the raw provider usage block equals the values PydanticAI parsed.
field_notes.served_by: 'model' = genuine model call; 'portkey_response_cache_replay' = Portkey returned a stored response (x-portkey-cache-status HIT), excluded from all totals.
